selection: Piecewise-constant authored periods with explicit 1961 overseas-territory and 2003 overseas-collectivity identity transitions; ratings remain local project estimates.
limitations: All numeric ratings are project estimates with low confidence, not source measurements.
France-wide sports evidence is not inherited automatically.
No tennis federation membership or organised competition is inferred.
Constitutional, territorial or administrative status is context only, not direct sports-performance evidence.
No rankings, titles or athlete outcomes are used to fit ratings.
